name: Alaska
deck: A U.S. state in the extreme northwest portion of the North American continent.

name: Alberta
deck: A province in Canada

name: Ankh Dimension
deck: The Ankh Dimension was created by the In-Betweener.

name: Antarctica
deck: Earth's southernmost continent that contains the South Pole.

name: Arizona
deck: A state located in the southwestern region of the United States.

name: Asgard
deck: Asgard is the dimension that is inhabited by the Asgardians or Norse gods. It is the highest of the nine worlds that make up Norse cosmology. Asgard refers to both the dimensions, kingdom, and city of the Norse gods.

name: Astral Plane
deck: The Astral Plane is the plane of minds. To access the astral plane, you must be telepathic or have some other source of power, such as magic.

name: Atlantic Ocean
deck: One of the five oceans on the Earth's surface.

name: Atlantis
deck: Atlantis was a myth described by Plato as an advanced society that sank into the sea. Many comics use it as a source of technology, magic, or advanced beings, either in the ancient past or undersea.

name: Attilan
deck: Attilan was formally the city of the Inhumans and was last located floating off the coast of Manhattan until it's destruction from the detonation of the terragenesis bomb.

name: Avengers Compound
deck: The Avengers Compound is a 15 acre estate located at 1800 Pales Verdes Drive on the Pacific coastline south of Los Angeles, California. It was the former headquarters of the West Coast Avengers and later the Avengers Academy

name: Avengers Mansion
deck: A luxurious town house located on Fifth Avenue in Manhattan, New York, the Avengers Mansion is the home and main base of the Avengers.

name: Baxter Building
deck: Just east of Fifth Ave. in Midtown Manhattan stands the Baxter Building. The 6 top floors are the home of the Fantastic Four. It's a 35-story building located at 42nd Street and Madison Avenue in New York City. It had been built in 1949 by the Leland Baxter Paper Company.

name: Belgium
deck: Central European country. The European Union HQ is located here.

name: Bifrost
deck: The Rainbow Bridge that provides access to the realm of Asgard.

name: Blue Area of the Moon
deck: Created by the Skrulls in a competition held against the Kree and the Cotati, it has been the home of Uatu the Watcher and the Inhumans

name: Bolivia
deck: Country located in South America.

name: Boston
deck: The city of Boston, Massachusetts is the unofficial "Capital of New England" and one of America's largest and oldest cities.

name: Brand Corporation
deck: Technological research company.

name: Brooklyn
deck: One of the five New York City boroughs.

name: California
deck: California is a state on the West Coast of the United States

name: Camp Lehigh
deck: Camp Lehigh is an army base.

name: Canada
deck: A country in North America containing 10 provinces and 3 territories.

name: Cape Military Base
deck: "The Cape" is the military base in Florida where Captain Marvel initially worked under the guise of Walter Lawson.

name: Centerville
deck: A fictional California town and the hometown of Patsy Walker (a.k.a. Hellcat).

name: Central Park
deck: A public park in Manhattan.

name: Chandilar
deck: Throneworld of the Shi'ar Empire.

name: Chicago
deck: The largest city of Illinois and the third-most populated city in the United States. It is nicknamed "The Windy City".

name: Chronopolis
deck: Immortus/Kang's city in the future.

name: Citadel of Science
deck: The High Evolutionary's original space-worthy base located on Wundagore Mountain.

name: Citrusville, Florida
deck: A fictional town in Florida near to the portion of the Everglades where Man-Thing resides.

name: Coney Island
deck: Neighborhood in New York City.

name: Connecticut
deck: One of America's 50, it is among the first states in the union as well as the smallest but is densely-populated and situated in the New England region.

name: Costa Verde
deck: Fictional Marvel country located in Central America.

name: Count Nefaria's Castle
deck: Count Nefaria's castle located in Alberta, Canada.

name: Counter-Earth
deck: After the heroes of Earth died in battle with Onslaught, Franklin Richards created a pocket universe for them during the Heroes Reborn event.

name: Daily Bugle Building
deck: A building that is 46 stories high located in New York City, on 39th Street and Second Avenue that publishes The Daily Bugle newspapers from the three floors. It is owned by by J. Jonah Jameson.

name: Danger Room
deck: The Danger Room is the training area for the X-Men and is located in Xavier Mansion.

name: Darkforce Dimension
deck: A cold and dark dimension composed of Darkforce Matter.

name: Deneb IV
deck: A world that once hosted one of the six infinity gems.

name: Denver, Colorado
deck: The capital of Colorado. Among others things Denver is the home of a subsidiary of Stark Industries called Stark Prosthetics.

name: Earth
deck: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and is the only planet that contains organic life forms. It is sometimes referred to as The World, The Blue Planet or its Latin name Terra.

name: Earth-691
deck: Home reality of Killraven and the original Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Earth-8410
deck: A year in the future which inhabited by the likes of Iron Man 2020, Death's Head II (Minion), Death Wreck, Death Metal, Spider-Girl 2020, and Wild Thing (Nikki Doyle).

name: Egypt
deck: Located in North Africa, Egypt is the home of the ancient Egyptian civilization, famous for its temples, mummies and pyramids.

name: Empire State University
deck: A New York college attended by many superheroes and supervillains.

name: England
deck: A country in the United Kingdom.

name: European Russia
deck: Russia is by far the largest country in the world and home country of several heroes.

name: Eximietatius
deck: A small 31st Century Kingdom ruled over by Princess Ravonna and once served as home to Kang the Conqueror.

name: Florida
deck: Florida is a state located in the southeastern United States, known by the nickname "the Sunshine State".

name: Flushing, Queens
deck: Flushing is a neighborhood in the New York City borough of Queens.

name: Forest Hills
deck: A neighborhood in queens where Peter Parker used to live.

name: Forest Hills Residence
deck: The Forest Hills residence of the Parker family was the original residence of Spider-Man. He eventually moved out. But the house has figured in many later adventures.

name: France
deck: The French Republic is located in Western Europe.

name: French Polynesia
deck: A large numbered group of relatively isolated islands in the South Pacific, it is considered France's only overseas country (legally distinct from its many overseas territories). Most appearances of French Polynesia will be the main island Tahiti though others like Ruruta or the Marquesas have appeared in comics as well.

name: Gamma Base
deck: Gamma Base, a secret research area whose prime directive was to study and cure the creature known as The Hulk from his human half Dr. Bruce Banner. Now it serves as home base for the former General Thaddeus Ross, who has since become the Red Hulk.

name: Garrett Castle
deck: Garret Castle has served as the headquarters of the Black Knights for centuries. Originally built in Europe and used by Percy of Scandia. Nathan Garret had it transferred and rebuilt in the United States. It was inherited by Dane Whitman and later acquired by Victoria Bentley.

name: Genosha
deck: An island nation off the east coast of Africa. Once known for the enslavement of mutants, Genosha was ruled by Magneto before being destroyed by Cassandra Nova.

name: Georgia State
deck: Georgia is a state in the southeastern region of the United States, its capital is Atlanta.

name: Germany
deck: The Federal Republic of Germany is a country in Central Europe.

name: Gibraltar
deck: Gibraltar is a British oversees territory, located at the southern tip of the Iberian peninsula. It is located just to the north of Morocco, where Europe meets Africa and the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean.

name: Greece
deck: In modern day, Greece is one of many smaller countries in the Balkan region of Southeast Europe but historically its ancient civilization was the starting point for many philosophical and cultural aspects of the Western world. This has resulted in its ancient mythology and figures being some of the most frequently used in artistic mediums like comics.

name: Greenwich Village
deck: Upscale neighborhood in New York City. Once known for its bohemian inhabitants.

name: Hala
deck: Capital World of the Kree Empire.

name: Hank Pym's Laboratory
deck: Laboratory located at Crofton University in Washington, D.C.

name: Hawaii
deck: The early home of Superboy, Kon-El and of other superhero and villains. Superboy was known to be "The Hero of Hawaii". Rex and Roxy Leech, Sam Makoa, Tana Moon, King Shark, Silver Sword, the Suicide Squad, and the Silicon Dragons also resided in Hawaii.

name: Hebrides
deck: There are the Inner & Outer Hebrides -- the most north-western group of islands in Scotland.

name: Houston
deck: Houston is the largest city in Texas and the fourth-largest city in the United States. It is a major business and energy production city

name: Hulk's Underground Cave
deck: This was an underground cave located beneath the New Mexico desert.

name: Hungary
deck: Central European country, member of the European Union. Budapest is its capital city.

name: Idaho
deck: One of America's 50.

name: Illinois
deck: Illinois is one of the fifty United States. It's capital is Springfield.

name: Indiana
deck: The "Land of the Indians" is a state located in the midwestern region of the US. Its capital is Indianapolis.

name: Iowa
deck: A state located in the Midwestern region of the United States.

name: Isle of Silence
deck: Region of Asgard, home of the Silent Ones, place of exile for those who would harm Asgard.

name: Japan
deck: The Land of the Rising Sun.

name: Jupiter
deck: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and is the largest in our solar system. It is famous for its giant red spot and its many moons.

name: Kansas
deck: Kansas is a Midwestern state of the US. Its capital city is Topeka, and other cities of interest are Smallville, Keystone City and Lawrence.

name: Khystym
deck: Khystym,or The Forbidden Zone, is an area of Russia that was irradiated by a nuclear explosion.

name: Kosmos
deck: Planet of Kosmosians.

name: Kree-Lar
deck: Kree-Lar was once the capital of the Kree Empire but in the wake of The Annihilation War it has become the heart of the ceded and occupied territories now ruled over by Ravenous and The Annihilation Wave.

name: Las Vegas
deck: The most populous city in the state of Nevada, and the heart of gaming and entertainment in the US. Sometimes referred to as "Sin City".

name: Latveria
deck: An Eastern European country ruled by Victor Von Doom. Its capital city is Doomstadt.

name: Limbo Dimension
deck: The Limbo Dimension exists outside of the timestream and is the base of Immortus. Within the Limbo Dimension, any time period in any reality can be reached.

name: London
deck: The capital city of England and the United Kingdom.

name: Long Island
deck: Long Island is an island located in southeastern New York, USA, its western shores directly across from Manhattan, from which the island stretches northeast into the Atlantic Ocean. It contains four counties, two of which (Queens and Kings) are boroughs (Queens and Brooklyn) of New York City, and two of which (Nassau and Suffolk) are suburbs of that city. Long Island Sound is the body of water between its northern shore and the state of Connecticut.

name: Los Angeles
deck: The "City of Angels" is the home of Hollywood and the center of the American film industry. It is also the largest city in the state of California and the second-largest in the United States.

name: Louisiana
deck: One of the fifty united states of America.

name: Manhattan
deck: The oldest and most densely populated borough of New York City.

name: Maryland
deck: Maryland is a state located in the eastern region of the United States

name: Mazikhandar
deck: An oil-rich dictator state in the Middle East which was liberated by the Invaders.

name: Metro College
deck: Metro College is an educational institution of the Marvel Universe. Former students include Jean Grey, Johnny Storm, Ted Roberts, Misty Knight, Calvin Rankin and Wyatt Wingfoot.

name: Mexico
deck: The United Mexican States is a country in North America that contains 31 free and sovereign states.

name: Miami
deck: The second largest city in Florida.

name: Mississippi
deck: One of America's 50 states, it is set in the Deep South and is neighbored by Louisiana, Alabama, Arkansas, and Tennessee.

name: Missouri
deck: Missouri is a state in the Midwestern region of the US.

name: Montana
deck: A state in the Western region of the United States of America.

name: Moscow
deck: Capital of Russia and also the Capital of the Soviet Union between 1922–1991

name: Nebraska
deck: Nebraska is a state located in the Midwestern region of the US

name: Nevada
deck: Nevada is a state located in the western region of the US.

name: New Jersey
deck: New Jersey is a state located in the Northeastern United States with its coast on the Atlantic Ocean.

name: New Mexico
deck: New Mexico is a state located in the southwestern region of the US. It is the 47th state.

name: New Orleans
deck: New Orleans is perhaps the most famous city in the Southern United States. It has benefitted from the fact that it sits at the mouth of the Mississippi River and bubbles with the many influences that arrived through river traffic over several centuries.

name: New York City
deck: The most populous city in the United States.

name: New York State
deck: The Empire State.

name: Newfoundland and Labrador
deck: A province in Canada

name: Norway
deck: The Kingdom of Norway, is a constitutional monarchy in Northern Europe that occupies the western portion of the Scandinavian Peninsula.

name: Office of Dr. Donald Blake
deck: The medical office of Dr. Donald Blake, silver age mortal form of Thor.

name: Ohio
deck: A midwestern state of the United States.

name: Osaka
deck: Third largest city in Japan. Capital of the Osaka Prefecture.

name: Osaka Prefecture
deck: A prefecture in Japan. The capital is the city of Osaka.

name: Otherworld
deck: Annwn is the afterlife world in Welsh mythology and is ruled by the Celtic god Arawn.

name: Pacific Ocean
deck: The Pacific Ocean bounds Asia and Australia to the West, the Americas to the East, the Arctic to the North and Antarctica to the South. Its various inhabited island are sometimes counted as the continent of Oceania. It is the largest ocean on Earth.

name: Paris
deck: Capital of France.

name: People's Republic of China
deck: China is the largest country in East Asia and one of the most populous countries in the world.

name: Peru
deck: The Republic of Peru is a country in western South America. Lima is its capital city.

name: Philadelphia
deck: The fifth most populous city in the US. It served as the former capital of the country, and was instrumental in the countries independence from Britain.

name: Pluto
deck: Pluto is the second-largest dwarf planet in the Solar System and the tenth largest body orbiting the Sun. It was discovered by Clyde William Tombaugh in 1930. The Disney character Pluto created that year was named after the planet.

name: Polemachus
deck: Polemachus is a extra dimensional world ruled by Arkon.

name: Queens
deck: The easternmost of the five boroughs of New York City and the largest in area and the second-largest in population since 1899.

name: Rigel
deck: Home planet of the Rigellians, the "Colonizers"

name: Rocky Mountains
deck: A North American mountain range located in several Canadian provinces as well as American states.

name: Ryker's Island
deck: A New York City jail where each cell is designed specifically for each super-prisoner. Many of Spider-Man's, Avenger's and Fantastic Four's foes are locked in this special state prison. It was originally called Island Prison.

name: San Francisco
deck: San Francisco is located in California, on the west coast of the United States.

name: Sanctum Sanctorum
deck: Doctor Strange's Greenwich Village mansion.

name: Santo Marco
deck: Fictional South American nation.

name: Saturn
deck: Saturn is the sixth planet of the Solar System and the second-largest. It is famous for its spectacular system of planetary rings. The planet is a gas giant and has a small solid core of rock and ice. The rest of it is mostly composed of hydrogen and (to a lesser degree) helium.

name: Scotland
deck: Scotland also called Skotland (Scots) and Alba (Gaelic) is a country in Northern Europe. It is currently part of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

name: Sea Of Eternal Night
deck: A place beyond the realm of Death, infested with dark magical forces. It contains the "Sword Of Doom" for safekeeping.

name: Selandiar
deck: The orbital spaceport serving selandiar, councill plant or the intergalactilc powers.

name: Serbia
deck: Serbia is a European country bordering Hungary, Romania, Bulgaria, the Republic of Macedonia, Albania, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina (Federal State) and Montenegro. The province of Kosovo has declared its independance since 2008 but received only limited recognition so far,

name: Siberia
deck: The coldest part of Russia and entire northern region of Asia (as well as the entire Asian region of Russia).

name: Skullhouse
deck: Former home of Silvermane, Red Skull and Sisters of Sin.

name: Slorenia
deck: Fictional Marvel country located in Europe.

name: Slovakia
deck: A Central European state and a member of the European Union. Along with the Czech Republic it formed the wider state of Czechoslovakia from 1918 to 1992. It has borders with the Czech Republic, Austria, Poland, Ukraine and Hungary.

name: Soulworld
deck: The dimension inside the Soul Gem. After the events of Infinity Wars nearly all character fusions from that storyline now resides here.

name: South Dakota
deck: One of the fifty United States of America.

name: Space
deck: The final frontier, the sea of space, the vast gulf between stars

name: Switzerland
deck: The Swiss Confederation is a landlocked alpine country in Western Europe. Its capital city is Berne and one of its main tourist attractions are the Swiss Alps.

name: Tarnax IV
deck: Tarnax IV was the throneworld of the Skrull Empire before it was consumed by Galactus.

name: Texas
deck: Texas is a state located in the South Central United States.

name: The Bronx
deck: The Bronx is one of the five boroughs of New York City. Since many of its inhabitants belong to lower socio-economic classes, it often appears as the home or headquarters of villains and criminals.

name: The Dark Dimension
deck: The realm of Dormammu that connects to pocket dimensions.

name: The Haven
deck: A castle on the Hudson river owned by the master geneticist called the High Evolutionary and the former home of his creations - the animal men called the Knights of Wundagore.

name: The Moon
deck: Earth's only natural satellite.

name: The Negative Zone
deck: The Negative Zone is an parallel antimatter universe. Discovered by Reed Richards of the Fantastic Four, it was initially referred to as Sub-Space. It is the birthplace of Annihilus.

name: The Pentagon
deck: Located in Arlington, Virginia, the Pentagon is the headquarters of the United States Department of Defense.

name: The Timestream
deck: In the DC Universe, the timestream is a place unaffected by time flows and a place used by the Monitors and time travelers in order to travel and correct time fluctuation.

name: Titan
deck: Titan is the largest moon of the planet Saturn and the only natural satellite known to have a dense atmosphere. In the Marvel Universe, it is home to the race of Titans (an offshoot of the Eternals), including the mutant Thanos. In the 30th Century DC Universe, Titan is populated by a race of telepaths and is the homeworld of Saturn Girl, a founding member of the Legion of Super-Heroes.

name: Tombstone, Texas
deck: Settlement in Texas and formerly home to Marvel's Western gunslingers in the 1800s. For a time it was ruled by the time-travelling Kang the Conqueror.

name: Transia
deck: Transia is a fictional European country on the Earth of the Marvel Universe. It is located between Transylvania, Romania and Serbia and is home to Mount Wundagore.

name: Unspecified North Africa
deck: A region that when unspecified will virtually always be in the Saharan desert that covers a great portion of Northern Africa.

name: Unspecified South America
deck: In comics, an unspecified region of South America as opposed to a specific country will primarily be the Amazon or Andes but even these will usually be associated with Brazil or Peru respectively.

name: Unspecified Sub-Saharan Africa
deck: The portion of the African continent that is south of the Sahara desert, it can be divided further into its own regions (East, West, Southern and Central) but when an unspecified portion of Africa appears in comics, it is often impossible to distinguish what more specific region it is representing.

name: Vermont
deck: One of America's 50 states.

name: Vietnam
deck: Vietnam is a country located in Southeast Asia. It is the easternmost country on the Indochina Peninsula and is bordered by China to the north, Laos to the northwest, Cambodia to the southwest, and the South China Sea to the east.

name: Virginia
deck: The Commonwealth of Virginia became one of the United States of America when it declared its independence from Britain on May 15, 1776. Strategically located in the middle of the Atlantic coast, Virginia is home to Norfolk Naval Base and The Pentagon.

name: Wakanda
deck: Wakanda is an African nation in the Marvel universe ruled by the Black Panther. It is technologically superior to most developed nations and rich in natural resources, particularly the rare metal vibranium.

name: Washington D.C.
deck: The capital of the United States.

name: White House
deck: The official residence and principal workplace of the President of the United States. Located at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW in Washington, D.C., it was built between 1792 and 1800 of white-painted Aquia sandstone in the late Georgian style and has been the executive residence of every U.S. President since John Adams.

name: Wundagore Mountain
deck: Wundagore Mountain (alternatively "Mount Wundagore" or "Mt. Wundagore") is a part of the mountain range in Transia.

name: Xavier Institute
deck: The Xavier Mansion has been home to the X-Men since their inception, and has always been a school and safe haven for any mutants in need.
